parent.description: Config type instance that contains this config child.

priority.description: Relative priority for processing.  In each sweep, the queue will get this many "slices" for dispatching computes.

batchSize.description:
Batch size for queue processing.  Each compute call will receive (at most), entries for this many groups,
determined by the queue's grouping.  Note that there can be multiple entries for each group so the actual
number of entries processed may be higher.

maxEntries.description: The maximum number of entries that will be passed into compute, even if batchSize has not been reached.

disabled.description: If true, the queue will be ignored and not processed.
